LanguageData.BOR_Kylar_Xar_Computer.label: Kylar-Xar effect computer
LanguageData.BOR_Kylar_Xar_Computer.description: The application of Kylar-Xar effect state in computer design enables us to bypass the limitations of our industrial era designs. To create the conditions for these quantum states our computers must double as cryogenic chambers. This will require enormous systems of coolant and temperature mitigation. Only a single Kylar-Xar effect computer is needed.
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_I.label: holotool cabinet
LanguageData.BOR_ToolCabinet_I.description: Increases work speed when placed near a workbench via hardlight projection technology. One workbench can use up to three holo-cabinets.
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_I.label: solar moisture pump
LanguageData.BOR_MoisturePump_I.description: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.
